name: Household altar
definition: Cabinet, shelf or box shrine kept in a home or room to hold sacred images, name tablets or talismans. Comes in modern, karaki or gold-leaf styles, wall-hung or mini.

name: Shrine rope
definition: Rope hung to mark a sacred space or object in a rite. A seasonal festival decoration such as the kadomatsu is in Decor.

name: Devotional panel painting
definition: Sacred picture painted on a rigid panel, framed or mounted to stand or hang.

name: Devotional scroll painting
definition: sacred picture painted or printed on cloth or paper and mounted as a hanging scroll or rolled for hanging (thangka, kakejiku honzon scroll, pata).

name: Altarpiece
definition: Large sacred picture or carved screen made to stand behind or above an altar, old-master altarpieces included.

name: Devotional statue
definition: Sculpted figure of a holy person, deity or saint made to be venerated.

name: Devotional cross
definition: Cross, with or without a figure on it, made to stand, hang or be held in veneration.

name: Nativity set
definition: Boxed or composed set of figures and a stable showing the birth of Jesus, sold as one set.

name: Relic
definition: Body part or belonging of a holy person, or a thing touched to one, kept for veneration. Relics are classed first, second or third class.

name: Reliquary
definition: case or container made to hold and show a relic.

name: Prayer beads
definition: String or loop of beads, knots or counters made to count prayers, with or without a cross, counter, tassel or guru bead. A necklace of the same beads made as jewellery is in Jewellery.

name: Prayer rug
definition: Rug or mat made to kneel, stand or prostrate on in prayer. Padding, non-slip base and surface fabric vary; a meditation cushion or mat is in Soft Furnishings.

name: Prayer wheel
definition: cylinder holding written prayers, turned by hand, wind or water.

name: Prayer flag
definition: cloth flag printed with prayers or sacred images, hung to be blown by the wind.

name: Devotional medal
definition: Loose medal of a saint or sacred subject made for devotion. One made with a chain or bail to be worn is in Jewellery; one struck to commemorate or reward is in Coins, Stamps, Medals & Trading Cards.

name: Prayer card
definition: Printed card with a sacred image or prayer, kept or carried for devotion.

name: Holy-water font
definition: small basin for holy water, hung or stood by a door or in a room.

name: Holy-water bottle
definition: bottle or flask made to hold blessed water.

name: Protective charm
definition: Small charm carried, not worn as jewellery, for luck, protection or a named blessing. A worn one is in Jewellery; one issued for money is in Coins, Stamps, Medals & Trading Cards.

name: Ritual cup
definition: Cup or goblet made to hold wine or another drink used in a rite.

name: Monstrance
definition: display vessel with a window or frame, made to show a consecrated host.

name: Seder plate
definition: Plate or tray made to hold the symbolic foods of a rite. The food itself is not included.

name: Aspergillum
definition: sprinkler for holy water.

name: Torah pointer
definition: slim rod ending in a pointing hand, held to follow the text when reading a scroll aloud.

name: Ritual sceptre
definition: short sceptre held in the hand in a rite.

name: Ritual knife
definition: Knife or blade made to be held in a rite, not to cut.

name: Mezuzah case
definition: Case made to hold a doorpost scroll and be fixed to a doorpost. Comes in several materials.

name: Mezuzah scroll
definition: Handwritten parchment strip of sacred text made to be put in a case and fixed to a doorpost. Script style and size (to fit the case) vary.

name: Tefillin
definition: pair of small boxes holding handwritten sacred passages, with straps, made to be strapped to the arm and head in prayer.

name: Shofar
definition: horn made to be blown in a rite.

name: Hand bell
definition: Bell held by a handle and rung in a rite or service.

name: Standing bowl bell
definition: Bowl-shaped bell that rests on a cushion or stand and is struck with a striker, made for a rite. A singing bowl made for music is in Musical Instruments & Music Gear.

name: Slit drum
definition: hollow wooden block struck to keep rhythm in chanting (mokugyo a named form).

name: Hanukkah lamp
definition: nine-branch lamp or candle holder, eight places for the festival lights and one for the helper light.

name: Seven-branch menorah
definition: seven-branch lamp or candle holder.

name: Oil lamp for worship
definition: Lamp burning oil or ghee, made for worship.

name: Eternal light
definition: Lamp kept burning before a sanctuary or altar. Electric or LED versions exist.

name: Altar candlestick
definition: Candle holder made to stand on or by an altar in a rite. An open candle holder for the home is in Decor.

name: Ritual candle
definition: Candle made for a rite or devotion, including altar, votive, procession, Easter, grave, Yahrzeit and memorial candles.

name: Advent wreath
definition: wreath with candles used to count the weeks before Christmas.

name: Ritual lantern
definition: Lantern made to be hung or set out in a rite or as a shrine offering. A garden stone lantern or decorative lantern is in Decor; a lantern made to be carried as a light is in Lighting.

name: Ritual incense
definition: Incense made for a rite, in stick, cone, resin or church grade. A smudge bundle made for a named rite is included.

name: Incense burner
definition: Standing or hanging vessel for burning incense, including holders for the grave.

name: Swung censer
definition: Incense burner hung on chains, to be swung.

name: Offering vessel
definition: Bowl, cup or vase made to hold water, rice, tea, flowers or other offerings, including flower vases for the grave.

name: Tarot deck
definition: 78-card deck with major and minor suits, sold for divination. Each published deck design is listed under its publisher. A pack sold for card play is in Toys & Games.

name: Oracle deck
definition: deck of cards with its own set of images and messages, any number of cards, sold for divination.

name: Lenormand deck
definition: 36-card deck of the Lenormand pattern, sold for divination.

name: Crystal ball
definition: sphere used for scrying.

name: Spirit board
definition: Lettered board with a pointer, made for divination. One made as a board game is in Toys & Games.

name: Rune set
definition: set of stones, wood or tiles marked with runes, made for casting.

name: I Ching coin set
definition: coins or sticks made for casting the I Ching.

name: Divination pendulum
definition: weight on a chain or cord, made to be dangled for divination.

name: Coffin
definition: Box that holds a body for burial or cremation. Material, steel gauge, shape, sealing and biodegradable options vary; rental caskets are included.

name: Cremation urn
definition: Container for cremated remains, of any capacity from a keepsake portion to a companion pair. Not a worn piece of jewellery; pet urns are included.

name: Scattering urn
definition: container made to release ashes on land, water or from the air.

name: Urn vault
definition: outer box or liner made to hold an urn in the ground.

name: Grave marker
definition: stone or plaque set on or at a grave (tombstone, tomb slab named forms).

name: Memorial tablet
definition: Tablet that stands for a dead person, inscribed with a name, kept at an altar or home.

name: Funeral pall
definition: cloth laid over a coffin (coffin cover a named form).

name: Burial shroud
definition: cloth or set of cloths that wrap the body.

name: Torah finial
definition: Ornament fitted to the top of the rollers of a Torah scroll.

name: Coffin plate
definition: plate fixed to a coffin, naming the dead.

name: Coffin pillow
definition: pillow made for the inside of a coffin.

name: Urn plaque or medallion
definition: plaque, appliqué or medallion made to be fixed to an urn.

name: Ritual hand drum
definition: Small two-headed hand drum, often hourglass-shaped with pellets on cords, rattled or struck in a rite. One sold for music is in Musical Instruments & Music Gear.

name: Ritual hand cymbals
definition: Pair of small thick cymbals joined by a cord, struck together in a rite. Ones sold for meditation are in Musical Instruments & Music Gear.

name: Memorial register
definition: Book or folding album made to record the names and death dates of the dead, kept at a household altar.

name: Dowsing rod
definition: Rod, pair of L-rods or forked rod made to be held for dowsing or divination. One sold as a survey or pipe-finding tool is in Tools & Workshop Equipment.

name: Paper-streamer wand
definition: Wand of zigzag paper or metal-foil streamers set at a shrine or household altar as the sign of the kami's presence (gohei, kinpei named forms).

name: Ritual spoon or ladle
definition: Spoon or ladle made to pour or offer water, ghee or a sacrament in a rite.

name: Miniature stupa
definition: Small model of a stupa or chorten made to stand on an altar as a sacred focus, filled with relics or mantras or not.

name: Host vessel
definition: Lidded cup, bowl or box made to hold consecrated or unconsecrated hosts.

name: Alms box
definition: Box, plate or basket made to collect money given as alms, charity or offering in religious practice (church collection box, tzedakah box, saisen box named forms).

name: Spice box
definition: Small box or tower made to hold fragrant spices smelled in the Havdalah rite.

name: Ritual washing cup
definition: Cup, usually two-handled, made to pour water over the hands in ritual washing.

name: Torah scroll
definition: Handwritten scroll of the Five Books on parchment, made to be read in the rite. A printed Torah or Bible is in Media & Publications.

name: Offering stand
definition: stand or tray made to hold offerings.
